title: Oven Roasted Croatian Chickpea Salad
description: A delicious and healthy salad with roasted chickpeas and a hint of Croatian flavor. This salad is perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: 2. Rinse the chickpeas and pat them dry with a paper towel.
3. In a bowl, mix together the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
4. Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
5. Drizzle the olive oil over the chickpeas and toss to coat.
6. Spread the chickpeas on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until crispy.
7. While the chickpeas are roasting, prepare the salad ingredients.
8. In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, tomato, red onion, and parsley.
9. Once the chickpeas are done roasting, add them to the bowl and toss to combine.
10. Serve the salad immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
